notes.title: Play Crow's Requiem OPEN PROTOTYPE 💀🚨
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, new Collectors! 🚨[/h1][p][/p][p][b]Crow's Requiem open prototype has [url="https://ex-ignorantia.itch.io/crowsrequiem"]officially landed on our Itch page![/url][/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="qdmrKKtDW2Y;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]The GAMEPLAY[/h2][p]Join us in the Plaguelands to live your FIRST DAY AT THE JOB:[/p][p][/p][p]💀👉 [b]Choose your Crow Archetype:[/b] the Listener, the Whisperer, or the Enforcer.[/p][p]💀👉 [b]Explore the map:[/b] drive your truck across the city of New Horizon;[/p][p]💀👉 [b]Meet its Citizens & Factions:[/b] who will remember your actions towards them and shape your path in the game. [/p][p]💀👉 [b]Do the Work:[/b] receive and fulfill requests to collect the recently deceased (through the mini-game);[/p][p][/p][h2]The CITY[/h2][p]Explore New Horizon and its forgotten shopping malls, where believers search for holy signs on dirty napkins. Or, enter lawless compounds where a gun speaks louder than authority.[/p][h3]REMEMBER, COLLECTOR:[/h3][p]you are one of the few in this quarantined city who still see others face-to-face daily.[/p][p]You will enter temples, compounds, and barracks to reach your requested collections. Be ready, for they will each see you through the filter of their plans and creeds. [/p][p][/p][h2]WISHLIST & FOLLOW CROW'S[/h2][p]🚛👉 dig our #indiegame? Wishlist Crow's at Steam (it means a lot!) [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3859230/Crows_Requiem"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]See you all in New Horizon! 💀💚[/h3][h3]
[/h3]
